properties.name: type
properties.description: The type attribute specifies the [type of button](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#type).

properties.name: commandfor
properties.description: The [commandfor](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#commandfor) attribute turns a `<button>` into a command button that controls the given interactive element referenced by `id`.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: The disabled attribute can be set to [keep a user from clicking on the button](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#disabled).

properties.name: iconLeading
properties.description: Define an icon by its identifier (like e.g. _user_, compare to [Icons](https://design-system.deutschebahn.com/core-web/review/main/foundations/icons/overview)) to get displayed in front of the elements content.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Define an icon by its identifier (like e.g. _user_, compare to [Icons](https://design-system.deutschebahn.com/core-web/review/main/foundations/icons/overview)) to get displayed in front of the elements content.

properties.name: showIconLeading
properties.description:
Enables or disables the visibility of the leading icon.
For many components this property is optional to reflect Figma properties.

properties.name: showIcon
properties.description:
Enables or disables the visibility of the icon. The default value depends on the component.
For many components this property is optional to reflect Figma properties.

properties.name: iconTrailing
properties.description: Define an icon by its identifier (like e.g. _user_, compare to [Icons](https://design-system.deutschebahn.com/core-web/review/main/foundations/icons/overview)) to get displayed in front of the elements content.

properties.name: showIconTrailing
properties.description:
Enables or disables the visibility of the trailing icon.
For many components this property is optional to reflect Figma properties.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size attribute changes the font-size and other related sizes of the component.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of the component. Auto width based on children size, full width based on parent elements width.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Variant of the button. Only use one primary button as a CTA on a page; otherwise, use one of the adaptive buttons.

properties.name: wrap
properties.description: Determines whether the text should wrap when its parent container is too small, preventing overflow.

properties.name: noText
properties.description: Define the text next to the icon specified via the icon Property to get hidden.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The name attribute specifies a [name attributes value](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#name) for the button.

properties.name: form
properties.description: Associates the control with a form element

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value attribute specifies an initial [value for the button](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#value).

properties.name: command
properties.description: The [command](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#command) attribute specifies the action to perform on the element controlled by a `<button>` element.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Alternative for default slot/children. Do not use together with a text children/slot, as both will be rendered and result in duplicate labels.
